Connect to your Daythread backend to open your recordings, diary, chat, people, inbox, and settings.
One origin per line, in priority order. Use the same archive for every fallback. Your phone needs access through your LAN or private VPN.
HTTP is unencrypted. Use it only on a trusted private network.
Native recordings go to this profile. The archive has its own profile picker in Settings.
Save and test a connection first.
Record on your phone or connect an Omi pendant. Audio stays on this device until your backend confirms each upload.
Capture continues with the screen locked. The ongoing notification has a Stop button. Android can still interrupt recording; reopen the app to recover saved audio.
Completed 30-second chunks upload automatically when connected. A stopped recording may finish uploading while you review it.
On Omi, single click marks a moment and double click toggles a meeting hint. Short meeting hints and repeated flags are filtered by your backend.
All saved chunks have been confirmed by your backend.

Unsent audio stays in private app storage, with a 2 GB budget. Changing the connection or profile preserves the destination of queued recordings. Uninstalling or clearing app data removes local audio.
Upload scheduled. Offline recordings will retry when connected.
Allows Wi-Fi and other networks Android reports as unmetered.
Stop capture before changing its connection.
Allow the requested microphone or nearby-device permission to capture audio.
Bluetooth LE is unavailable on this phone.
Turn on Bluetooth, then try again.
No Omi found. Wake your pendant and disconnect it from other apps, then try again.
Bluetooth scan failed. Check Bluetooth and nearby-device permissions.
Your backend is out of reach.
Check the server and your network. Native capture and queued recordings are still available in Capture.
This download could not be saved. Try again while connected.
This export is too large to save here. Open Daythread in your browser to download it.

The archive uses the same responsive Daythread interface as the web app, including English and Danish. Capture is native Android. Apple Reminders and Calendar actions remain iPhone-specific; use portable exports on Android.
No queued audio is available to play.
Turning off stops live capture immediately. Saved recordings are kept. Manual recording is always available.
Choose at least one day and different start and stop times.
Manual override is active. Follow schedule to resume automatic recording.
Times follow this device’s time zone. Overnight windows belong to the day they start.

The ongoing capture service starts and stops automatically during scheduled hours. Keep its notification active. Reopen the app and follow the schedule after a force-stop, restart, or permission failure.
Schedule active · microphone off until the next window
